annotations: Roads rated from a traffic count that belongs to another stretch: MDOT SHA counts a whole section at one station, which can sit past a junction where a busier road joins, or on another route. Same principle as 2026-11-13-owner-bucklodge-road.json: rate the road from its own traffic (the same route counted next door, or the section count less the joining road, an estimate) by our rural rule. Only rural two-lane roads with one junction or a named station on another route are here; the audit is reports/borrowed-counts in the project files.
